analytics.name: Analytic 1753
analytics.guidance: Defender observes anomalous signaling network queries targeting subscriber information associated with a device, including unexpected routing requests, location information exchanges, or node-origin inconsistencies indicative of SS7 signaling abuse.  The CSRIC also suggests threat information sharing between telecommunications industry members.

tuning.description: Defines acceptable variance for signaling node identifiers
Baseline-dependent threshold for excessive subscriber queries
Expected signaling path vs observed routing anomalies

log_sources.name: TelecomLogs:SS7Signaling
log_sources.channel: Subscriber information queries, routing requests, or location update messages with anomalous node identifiers or unexpected origin patterns

log_sources.name: TelecomLogs:MobilityEvents
log_sources.channel: Unexpected location resolution events or abnormal subscriber tracking requests

analytics.name: Analytic 1754
analytics.guidance: Defender observes anomalous signaling interactions involving subscriber identity or location resolution events associated with a device, including abnormal routing requests, unexpected location information exchanges, or signaling node inconsistencies indicative of SS7 abuse.  The CSRIC also suggests threat information sharing between telecommunications industry members.

tuning.description: Baseline deviation tolerance for location resolution events
Expected vs observed signaling routing paths
Threshold for abnormal resolution or lookup behavior

log_sources.name: TelecomLogs:SS7Signaling
log_sources.channel: Location resolution, routing, or subscriber information exchanges with anomalous signaling paths or node identities

log_sources.name: TelecomLogs:MobilityEvents
log_sources.channel: Unexpected subscriber tracking or abnormal mobility/location resolution activity
